ImageDescription.value: This is a long shot of a pedestrian bridge leading from the Harbourfront Centre. (more about the centre later). Apparently some private yacht tours start from here. I was initially confused about the position of the bridge, wondering how a boat with such a tall mast could pass under it. Later on viewing the photograph I realized that the mast is part of the bridge itself, something like a decorative centre pylon- all the boards are short motor boats! Ok, give me a break, this was only a flash sighting from a moving bus! (Toronto, Canada, Nov.2015)
